cohort: 1,315 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) in governmental hospitals in Southwest Ethiopia
finding: This study found a high prevalence of neonatal birth injury and identified several associated factors, including primiparity, lack of antenatal care, low maternal education, unemployment, instrumental delivery, and maternal age between 25 and 34 years.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered via instrumental delivery had a 2.81 times higher risk of birth injury compared to those delivered by Cesarean section.
